name: Yolanda
self_text: I am a Canadian man in my 40s. Outside of gaming, I enjoy knitting because it helps me unwind. I play on PC. These days it's all Hollow Lantern for me. I'm mostly into casual matches. Most weeks I can do weekday evenings.

requests.request_text: I need you to be available weekday evenings. It would be nice if you are into casual matches, and a small bonus if you are into Hollow Lantern.
